description: File write/read round trip in Folder.temp with fixed name (deterministic); cleanup
source: var f = new File(Folder.temp + '/extmin-fixture-fixed.txt'); f.open('w'); f.writeln('line1'); f.writeln('line2'); f.close(); var g = new File(f.fsName); g.open('r'); var content = g.read(); g.close(); f.remove(); return {path: f.fsName.split(/[\\\/]/).pop(), content: content};
